Remark
[Sharpness of the volume-growth estimates] Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0037 1. Remark 4.4\group section-4

The metrics on $\R ^n$ that outside a compact set have the form \begin{equation} dr^2+r^{1\pm 2v}g \tag {4.51} \end{equation} show that Theorem 34 is sharp. Their injectivity angle decays no faster than $r^{-(n-1)(\frac12+v)}$.
